analysis.facts: Individual Ruby sources, extracted gem members and affected filesystem-container members inspected with cleave facts; no sample code executed.
analysis.scope: Explicit user endpoint-review labels govern final pools. Metasploit is accepted as a legitimate framework package with expected exploit-member matches; the specified standalone probes and PayloadsAllTheThings collection are bad.

rule_changes: Bind Ruby stream input to the executed Open3 command and returned child output; cover both copy_stream and socket.write(output.read).
Detect outbound and listening command shells separately from generic process and socket capabilities.
Bind Windows line-polling task replies to cmd/PowerShell execution, GET-result acquisition and POST command-output encoding; bind screenshot upload and deletion to the same filename.
Detect Base64/XOR reconstruction passed to Ruby eval, without asserting that the cross-language decoded stage executes successfully.
Require Base64-decoded data to be the actual system command argument; unrelated decoding and build-process calls no longer convict.
Move labeled Monero address patterns to data-format observations; retire their unsupported wallet-plus-mining-text conviction.
Move username-field reads to environment/user observations and NITRO endpoint references to HTTP path observations; require the actual NITRO path instead of a bare sshpubkey token.
Treat /sysinfo paths and sendmail capability as neutral observations.
Retire the temporary-path plus timestamp-outlier hidden-payload inference; preserve its independent archive metadata.
Identify the stock Thickbox 3 packed plugin using its title/author and overlay/navigation dictionary, and group existing exact jQuery plugin exceptions.
